motion.curve: cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0) StrongOut (PathInterpolator(0.2f, 0.0f, 0.0f, 1.0f)) for every background/opacity/translate tween; springs replace the curve on three specific releases (FAB release stiffness 500 damping 0.75, bubble enter on new message stiffness 420 damping 0.80, bottom-nav icon pop on selection stiffness 400 damping 0.70); press-down is always 0.97 scale over duration_short with no color flip; mic<->send morph crossfade duration_medium; dialog/drawer/bottom-sheet entries duration_long

components.description: ROOT ConstraintLayout, background #0F1512 full-bleed, status bar transparent with light icons via WindowInsetsControllerCompat set in HomeActivity.onCreate after super. TOP BAR replaces R.id.toolbar inside R.id.toolbar_container via a post-inflate pass hooked on HomeActivity.A5F and the AbstractActivityC03800Ie inflate finaliser: 64dp tall, no divider, no shadow, background #0F1512 (matches root so no seam). Left: a plain TextView injected in place of the stock title at 16dp start, display scale 28sp bold #E8F3EE, text 'Shadowzap' — stock Toolbar.setTitle is nulled out so our TextView controls typography. Right cluster at 16dp end: two 40x40dp circular ghost icon-buttons (QR scan, overflow 3-dots), each drawing a 24dp stroke vector in #E8F3EE, 44x44dp hit area, press feedback = 0.97 scale over 140ms StrongOut plus a #FFFFFF-at-8%-alpha circular state layer fading in 140ms out 100ms. No ripple color flip. SEARCH BAR injected as a sibling under R.id.conversation_container above the RecyclerView in ConversationsFragment layout 06d3: 56dp tall pill, horizontal margin 16dp, 8dp vertical margin, corner radius 28dp (full pill), background #1A2420, elevation 0, no border. Leading 24dp search glyph #B8C9C2 at 16dp start-pad, placeholder 'Ask Meta AI or Search' body 15sp regular #B8C9C2, trailing 24dp mic glyph #B8C9C2 at 16dp end-pad. Press state layer #2ECC71 at 8% alpha, scale 0.98. FILTER CHIPS: a horizontal LinearLayout injected into the ListView header view (currently 06d1), 48dp tall, 16dp start-pad, 8dp between chips, horizontally scrollable with the trailing edge of the row fading to #0F1512 via a 24dp-wide gradient drawable. Each chip is 36dp tall, horizontal padding 16dp, radius 18dp pill. Unselected: background #1A2420, text #E8F3EE 14sp medium. Selected: background #2ECC71, text #0F1512 14sp medium. Selection transition is a 180ms StrongOut background crossfade; press scale 0.97. Chips in order: 'All', 'Unread', 'Favorites', 'Groups'. ARCHIVED FOLDER ROW injected as the final child of the list-tip header layout 06d1 above the first chat row: 56dp tall, horizontal padding 16dp, 24dp archive-outline vec in #B8C9C2 at 16dp margin-start inside a 40dp circle of #141C19, 12dp gap, title 'Archived' 15sp medium #E8F3EE, trailing counter in tabular caption 12sp #B8C9C2 at 16dp end. The row is wrapped in a 16dp-radius inset card only when it is first-of-list: horizontal margin 12dp, inner surface #141C19 sitting on #0F1512; concentric check: outer 16dp card radius with 8dp inner padding = inner icon-circle radius 20dp (visually balanced). Press feedback: 0.97 scale 140ms, state layer #2ECC71 at 8%. CHAT ROWS rebuilt by wrapping C27741Mn.onBindViewHolder (and the ListView setAdapter path at ConversationsFragment line 3561 if that is the one hit on this build — hook both and let whichever fires take over): 76dp tall, horizontal padding 16dp. Avatar: 52dp circular WDSProfilePhoto override, 16dp margin-start, 2dp emerald ring #2ECC71 ONLY when unread_count > 0, otherwise no ring. 16dp gap, two-line stack: line 1 contact name 16sp semibold #E8F3EE truncated end-ellipsis; line 2 last-message preview 14sp regular #8CA399 single-line end-ellipsis, 2dp top margin. Trailing column 72dp wide right-aligned: timestamp 12sp #8CA399 with font-feature-settings 'tnum' so '09:12' and '14:48' do not shift; below (4dp gap) UNREAD badge, min-width 22dp, height 22dp, radius 11dp pill, background #2ECC71, text #0F1512 12sp bold tnum (counts '1' / '12' / '99+' never reflow — grafted from Lens 1's tabular discipline). Row press: 0.97 scale over 140ms StrongOut plus a #2ECC71 state layer at 8% alpha fading in 140ms out 100ms, NO ripple color flip. Row divider: none — rely on the 76dp rhythm and surface color alone (we chose borders OR shadows and here we chose neither). FAB (R.id.fab, swap drawable and background): 64dp circular, background #2ECC71, 28dp 'new-message' pencil-plus glyph in #0F1512. Shadow is two layered transparent paints: #2ECC71 at 24% alpha 12dp blur 4dp y-offset ABOVE a #000000 at 32% alpha 24dp blur 8dp y-offset. Position: 24dp from end, 24dp above the bottom nav. Press: 0.95 scale 160ms StrongOut, release spring stiffness 500 damping 0.75. BOTTOM NAV (R.id.bottom_nav): 72dp tall, background #141C19, no top divider, 16dp top corners rounded (concentric: outer 32dp FAB radius minus 16dp padding = inner 16dp bar corner). Four tabs Chats / Updates / Meta AI / Calls. Each item: 24dp icon above 11sp medium label. Selected item draws a 32dp x 56dp pill behind the icon in #2ECC71 at 20% alpha, icon tinted #2ECC71, label #2ECC71. Unselected: icon #8CA399, label #8CA399. Tab-switch motion: pill slides between items with a 220ms StrongOut translateX while the previous pill fades out and the new pill fades in; icon pops 1.0 -> 1.08 -> 1.0 on selection via spring stiffness 400 damping 0.70.

ROOT: R.id.coordinator (LockableCoordinatorLayout) background #0F1512. TOP BAR replaces the Toolbar inflated into R.id.conversation_toolbar_stub, hook ordering: C45851zi.BkF after-hook then Conversation.onCreate after super. 72dp tall, background #141C19, no divider (hairline 0.5dp #1F2A26 is painted only while R.id.list scrolled > 0dp, toggled from an OnScrollListener installed on setAdapter — grafted from Lens 1). Layout from start: 8dp padding, 40x40dp circular ghost back button holding a 24dp chevron-left #E8F3EE at 44dp hit area; 4dp gap, 44dp circular WDSProfilePhoto whose tap target wraps avatar + name block (76% of width); 12dp gap, two-line stack with name 17sp semibold #E8F3EE truncated end-ellipsis and subtitle 12sp regular #8CA399 — subtitle flips to #2ECC71 with a leading 6dp dot (dot pulses scale 1.0 -> 1.2 over 900ms sinusoidal infinite) when presence is 'online', shows 'typing...' with staggered dot alpha 0.3->1 over 400ms when typing, otherwise 'last seen HH:MM' with tnum. Trailing cluster: three 40x40dp ghost icon buttons (video-call, voice-call, overflow 3-dots), 24dp stroke icons #E8F3EE, 8dp between hit boxes, 8dp end padding, press scale 0.97 140ms, state layer #FFFFFF at 8%. IN-CALL BANNER (R.id.incall_baner): 44dp tall pill radius 22dp inset 16dp horizontal and 8dp below the top bar, background #2ECC71 solid, text #0F1512 15sp semibold with a tnum timer at the end. MESSAGE LIST (ConversationListViewImpl, keep ListView, hook setAdapter): background #0F1512, no row divider, clipToPadding false, top padding 8dp, bottom padding 96dp (clears composer). Vertical gap between rows: 2dp if same sender within 60s, 10dp when sender changes (tracked via adapter wrapper). INCOMING BUBBLE: start-aligned, max 78% width, FrameLayout container with shape-drawable background — radius topStart 20dp, topEnd 20dp, bottomEnd 20dp, bottomStart 6dp tail notch, fill #1A2420, no stroke, no shadow. Padding 12dp horizontal 10dp vertical. Text 15sp regular #E8F3EE lineSpacingMultiplier 1.25. Below text an inline flex row with timestamp 11sp tnum #8CA399 right-aligned, 6dp top margin. In group chats the sender name sits above the text at 13sp semibold with a per-jid color drawn from a seeded 10-color palette [#2ECC71 #4FC3F7 #FFB74D #F06292 #BA68C8 #81C784 #E57373 #64B5F6 #FFD54F #A1887F] indexed by the first 2 bytes of the jid. OUTGOING BUBBLE: end-aligned, max 78%, radius topStart 20dp topEnd 20dp bottomStart 20dp bottomEnd 6dp, fill #1E4A36 (deep emerald, muted — reads as 'yours' without flooding with pure accent), text #E8F3EE 15sp regular. Trailing meta row: timestamp 11sp tnum #B8D4C7 followed by 12dp ticks — sent = single stroke #B8D4C7, delivered = double stroke #B8D4C7, read = double stroke #4FC3F7 (brand-blue read-tick on purpose so it stands clear of accent emerald, grafted from the lens's own clarity rule). Grouping: consecutive bubbles from same sender within 60s collapse — second+ bubble gets 2dp top-margin and loses the tail (all four corners 20dp). Row enter animation on NEW arriving message: translateY 24dp->0 + alpha 0->1 over 260ms StrongOut and bubble scales 0.96 -> 1.0 via spring stiffness 420 damping 0.80. Long-press: bubble scales 1.03 over 140ms with haptic click, then an overlay action sheet rises. SYSTEM MESSAGES / DATE SEPARATORS: centered pill 32dp tall horizontal padding 14dp radius 16dp background #141C19 text #8CA399 11sp medium with tnum. Date pills sticky-float at top during scroll with a 180ms fade-in. REPLY QUOTE INSIDE BUBBLE: 2dp emerald #2ECC71 left-bar, 8dp start-padding, sender name 11sp semibold #2ECC71, quoted snippet 13sp #B8C9C2, max 2 lines ellipsized, 6dp bottom-margin above main text. COMPOSER (R.id.footer rebuilt): vertical LinearLayout, background #141C19, top corners 20dp rounded, elevation drawn as layered transparent shadows (#000000 at 28% alpha 20dp blur 0dp y-offset over #000000 at 16% alpha 32dp blur 8dp y-offset). Padding 12dp horizontal, 10dp vertical, 8dp top. Inner row 1 (edit pill): 48dp-min-height pill, radius 24dp, fill #0F1512 (inverted inset — background is darker than the composer bar on purpose). Inside pill left-to-right: 24dp emoji glyph #B8C9C2 at 12dp start, R.id.entry EditText flex-grow 1 15sp regular #E8F3EE hint 'Message' #8CA399 no underline 12dp vertical padding maxLines 6 with internal scroll, trailing 24dp paperclip + 24dp camera 12dp apart 12dp end-margin, each inside a 40dp circular hit target. Inner row 2 (morph FAB outside the pill): 56dp circular, 12dp from pill trailing edge, 12dp from screen edge. Empty-entry state = mic, background #2ECC71, 24dp mic glyph #0F1512. Non-empty-entry state = send, background #2ECC71, 24dp paper-plane #0F1512. Morph: 220ms StrongOut crossfade of background and icon with 15deg -> 0 rotation and 0.9 -> 1.0 scale. Press 0.95 160ms, release spring stiffness 500 damping 0.70. Voice-note recording state replaces the entire pill with a #0F1512 bar showing a mono tabular 00:03 counter, a 10dp pulsing red dot (#D64545), and a 'slide to cancel' chevron. Keyboard insets preserved via existing KeyboardPopupLayout. EXPRESSIONS TRAY (R.id.expressions_tray_view_id): slide up from bottom 260ms StrongOut, background #141C19, top corners 20dp.

ROOT (UpdatesFragment.A20 after-hook, FrameLayout we re-skin): background #0F1512 (override themed attr lookup). RecyclerView R.id.updates_list keeps LinearLayoutManager; adapter stays C36402Fuf, we wrap each item type via getItemView. Horizontal padding 0dp (padding is moved inside each row), top padding 8dp, bottom padding 96dp. SECTION HEADERS (section view types in C36402Fuf, hook onBindViewHolder for 'Status', 'Channels'): 48dp tall, 20sp semibold #E8F3EE at 16dp margin-start, 16dp top-margin, no divider underneath. MY STATUS ROW (first row, 80dp tall, horizontal padding 16dp): 56dp circular avatar with a RING drawn around it — empty = dashed 2dp #4A5A54 at 2dp inset; posted single = solid 3dp emerald gradient (#2ECC71 TL -> #4FD39A BR) at 2dp inset; posted multi = N equal arc segments of 3dp emerald separated by 4dp gaps, segment is #2ECC71 if recent / #4A5A54 if older. Overlaid at avatar bottom-right: 24dp circular button background #2ECC71 border 3dp #0F1512 holding a 12dp '+' glyph #0F1512, press scale 0.92 180ms StrongOut. 16dp gap, title 'My status' 16sp semibold #E8F3EE, subtitle 13sp regular #8CA399 showing 'Tap to add status' or '2 updates - 09:14' with tnum on the timestamp (grafted from Lens 1 / Lens 3 jitter-fix). Trailing: 40dp ghost icon-button camera (24dp #B8C9C2) with 44dp hit area firing the status camera. FRIEND STATUS ROWS: 76dp (matches home chat-row rhythm for continuity), horizontal padding 16dp, 52dp circular avatar with the same ring logic (segment arcs, unseen = #2ECC71, seen flips to #4A5A54), 16dp gap, name 16sp semibold #E8F3EE, subtitle 'today, 14:03' 13sp #8CA399 tnum, no trailing content. Press 0.97 scale 140ms, state layer #2ECC71 at 8%. Row divider: none (rely on 76dp rhythm). CHANNELS SECTION: section header 'Channels', then a horizontal RecyclerView carousel 164dp tall, 16dp start-pad, 12dp between items. Each channel card 128dp wide x 164dp tall, radius 20dp outer, fill #141C19, no border, no shadow, elevation 0. Inside: 128dp x 100dp cover image radius topStart/topEnd 20dp bottomStart/bottomEnd 0dp (concentric with the card at the shared edge), 12dp padding below for channel name 13sp semibold #E8F3EE 2-line clamp, follower count 11sp #8CA399 tnum ('12.4K'), optional 12dp verified checkmark #2ECC71 baseline-aligned (ImageSpan ALIGN_BASELINE) inline after name with 4dp gap. Press 0.97 scale 160ms. Below the carousel, 'Find channels' row: 56dp tall, horizontal padding 16dp, leading 24dp compass glyph #2ECC71 inside a 36dp circle of #2ECC71 at 16% alpha, label 15sp medium #E8F3EE, trailing 20dp chevron #8CA399. FABS: HomeActivity exposes R.id.fab and R.id.fab_second — on Updates we show both stacked, 24dp from end, lowest 24dp above the bottom nav. Primary (R.id.fab, 'write status') = 64dp emerald FAB with pencil glyph, same two-layer transparent shadow as home. Secondary (R.id.fab_second, 'camera status') = 48dp smaller FAB directly above primary, 12dp gap, background #1A2420, 20dp camera glyph #E8F3EE, no shadow but a 1dp stroke #2A3833 for separation (chose border over shadow here). B3m tooltip override: neutralized and replaced with a pill-shaped toast — radius 14dp, background #1A2420, 12sp medium #E8F3EE, 10dp horizontal 6dp vertical padding, 8dp gap to FAB, enters with alpha + translateX 180ms StrongOut. STATUS PLAYBACK OVERLAY (StatusPlaybackActivity.onCreate after-hook): background #000000. TOP: 2dp-tall segmented progress strip at the very top, 8dp horizontal gutter, 8dp top-margin below status bar. N equal-width segments, 4dp gaps, segment radius 1dp. Unfilled = #FFFFFF at 24% alpha, filled = #2ECC71 solid. Progress fills linearly over the segment duration using a linear interpolator (NOT StrongOut — timing accuracy matters); 180ms StrongOut fade when advancing between segments. Below strip: 56dp bar with 40dp circular avatar at start (16dp pad), name 15sp semibold #FFFFFF, timestamp 12sp #FFFFFFCC tnum, trailing 40dp overflow + 40dp close(X). BOTTOM: 56dp reply pill radius 28dp fill #FFFFFF at 10% alpha with backdrop blur when available (fallback semi-opaque #141C19), 'Reply' hint 15sp #FFFFFFB3, trailing 24dp heart + 24dp share icons. Press 0.97 scale 160ms. Chrome fades out after 2000ms idle over 240ms StrongOut and back in on tap. Preserve left/right tap-to-advance gesture.

ROOT (SettingsTabActivity, both A0x true/false variants): FORCE the A0x==true 'me-tab' layout (0x7f0e1084) via setContentView replace-hook because its MotionLayout header gives us the collapsing hero. Background #0F1512. Status bar transparent, light icons. HEADER (AppBarLayout 'me_tab_appbar_layout' + MotionLayout 'me_tab_motion_layout'): expanded height 280dp, collapsed height 72dp. EXPANDED state — y=0..180dp a flat 'cover' panel drawn as a linear vertical gradient drawable from #1E4A36 to #0F1512 (no photo); me_tab_cover_photo image is nulled and the WaImageView is tinted with the gradient drawable programmatically. At y=120dp a 104dp circular WDSProfilePhoto 'me_tab_profile_info_photo' centered horizontally with a 3dp solid ring #2ECC71 at 1dp inset so the photo overflows the cover (half above/half below the 180dp line onto the #0F1512 base). 16dp below the photo, display name (TextEmojiLabel 'me_tab_profile_info_name') 24sp bold #E8F3EE center-aligned. 4dp below name, '@username' 14sp regular #8CA399 center-aligned (hidden if null). 10dp below username, 'about' bubble (AboutChatViewBubble 'me_tab_about_bubble') with background pill radius 16dp (full pill when single-line) fill #1A2420 12dp horizontal 8dp vertical padding, text 13sp medium #E8F3EE center-aligned, press scale 0.98 opens edit. Top of header, a 56dp sub-bar overlay: 40dp ghost back-arrow (R.drawable.wa_ic_arrow_back tinted #E8F3EE) at 16dp start with 44dp hit area, 40dp ghost QR icon at 16dp end. WDSSearchBar pinned at the bottom of the AppBarLayout: 56dp tall, radius 28dp, fill #1A2420, hint 'Search settings' 15sp #B8C9C2, 20dp search glyph start, 16dp horizontal gutter, 12dp bottom-margin. COLLAPSED state (scroll-driven MotionLayout, 240ms StrongOut): cover gradient opacity 1.0->0.0; profile photo scales 104dp->32dp and translates to sit beside the toolbar title; name translates up and shrinks to 17sp semibold overlapping toolbar_profile_name; search bar pins and holds 56dp. WDSToolbar background interpolates from transparent to #0F1512 — hook WDSToolbar.setBackgroundColor so our after-hook enforces #0F1512 (no divider) regardless of theme; divider visibility forced off via setDividerVisibility. BODY (NestedScrollView 'settings_nested_scroll_view' > LinearLayout 'container'): top padding 8dp. Rows are WDSListItems — hook WDSListItem.<init> post-layout to restyle every row: 64dp min height, horizontal padding 16dp. Leading icon container: 40dp circle radius 20dp fill #2ECC71 at 14% alpha, inside sits the 24dp stroke vec icon tinted #2ECC71 (Shadowzap brand — all settings icons uniformly emerald so the eye reads 'this is your controlled surface'). Icon-circle padding 8dp (concentric: 20dp outer radius with 8dp pad centers the 24dp glyph optically). 16dp gap, title 16sp medium #E8F3EE, optional subtitle 13sp regular #8CA399 2dp below. Trailing: either a 20dp chevron-right #8CA399 OR a 22dp min-width pill badge radius 11dp fill #2ECC71 text #0F1512 11sp bold tnum (grafted from Lens 1 for anti-reflow). Row press: 0.995 scale over 140ms StrongOut, overlay #FFFFFF at 4% alpha fading in 140ms out 100ms, NO ripple color flip. SECTION GROUPING: rows are grouped into cards. Each card: horizontal margin 16dp, vertical margin 8dp between cards, radius 20dp outer, fill #141C19 (surface_elevated), no stroke, no shadow (contrast lift against #0F1512 is enough). Inside each card, inter-row spacing is 0dp and a 1dp #1F2A26 hairline is drawn between rows inset 56dp from start (icon column stays clean) — this is the one bent 'borders OR shadows' rule because 7+ grouped rows need a sub-noise-floor separator. Groups: Group A 'Account' = [Account, Privacy, Avatar, Chats, Notifications, Storage and data, App language]. Group B 'Help' = [Help, Invite a friend, App updates]. Group C 'Logout' = single destructive row: icon-circle fill #D64545 at 14% alpha, icon stroke #D64545, title 'Log out' 16sp medium #D64545, no chevron, press state layer #D64545 at 8%. FOOTER: 48dp tall label 'Shadowzap vXX - from Meta' 11sp regular #4A5A54 centered, 24dp bottom padding above the gesture bar. A0x==false fallback / SettingsFragment path (0x7f0e08fc) hooks A0i(int,int) to re-measure and injects the same card wrappers around dynamically-added WDSListItems — the card scheme is identical, so visual continuity is kept regardless of which layout the device ends up on.

rationale: Primary lens is Material 3 expressive (Lens 2) because it is the only one of the three that preserves the Shadowzap signature emerald #2ECC71 as its accent — Lens 1 uses iOS #30D158 and Lens 3 uses electric #10E39A, both of which would break continuity with the existing Shadowzap settings page the user already ships on #2A2A2A. Beyond the palette, M3 Expressive AMPLIFIES rather than fights WhatsApp's actual 2026 substrate — WDSToolbar, WDSListItem, WDSProfilePhoto, WDSSearchBar are all M3 under the hood, so re-skinning via post-inflate hooks is a shorter, more durable path than re-themeing an iOS or brutalist chrome on top of M3 components. The lens delivers the four hierarchy wins the brief asks for in a dense chat-centric app: (1) seamlessness — toolbar background matches body background #0F1512 so the top seam that appears on scroll in stock WA is gone, with a 0.5dp hairline only painted when the list has actually scrolled; (2) density discipline — 76dp chat rows, 72dp bottom nav, 64dp settings rows, 20sp section headers all give rooms-of-air without crowding; (3) signal clarity — the emerald is reserved for unread badges, selected tabs, status rings, read ticks (except read-blue which is kept #4FC3F7 for clarity), send button, in-call banner — the user's eye learns 'emerald = attention needed'; (4) expressive feedback — 0.97 scale with 180ms StrongOut and springs on three specific moments (FAB release, bubble enter, bottom-nav icon pop) gives the UI a physical feel without going cartoonish. GRAFTS from the runners-up — from Lens 1 (iOS minimalist) we imported: (a) hard tabular-numeral discipline on every timestamp, counter, timer and progress segment so rows never reflow when digits change, (b) press feedback that is scale-only with a low-alpha state layer rather than a background color flip, (c) scroll-conditional top-bar hairline on the chat screen (hairline appears only when R.id.list.scrollY > 0 via an OnScrollListener), (d) '99+' tabular-safe unread-count rendering, (e) the restrained 1E4A36 deep-emerald outgoing bubble instead of a pure #2ECC71 flood so content stays legible. From Lens 3 (neo-brutalist) we imported: (a) the strict read-tick color commitment (#4FC3F7 blue stays distinct from #2ECC71 accent so 'read' is never confused with 'unread'), (b) the status-playback progress strip animating on a LINEAR interpolator rather than StrongOut because timing accuracy matters more than visual flourish there, (c) a per-group 1dp hairline (and only 1dp, at #1F2A26, below the eye's noise floor) inside Settings cards so 7+ rows separate cleanly without cards exploding into individual tiles. What we did NOT take: Lens 3's hard offset-shadow brutalism, square avatars, mono-caps everywhere, and the 8dp sharp radii — all three would read as 'engineered utility' rather than the premium quiet feel the brief asks for, and would clash with WhatsApp's rounded M3 WDS components. Lens 1's demotion of accent to a signal-only role is partially adopted (chrome does not use emerald) but not fully, because the Shadowzap brand needs the FAB and send-button to carry the accent so the user feels the mod is live on every screen. Concentric radii hold across the system: FAB 32dp outer -> bottom-nav 16dp inner at 16dp padding; settings icon-circle 20dp outer -> glyph 16dp inner at 8dp pad; chat bubble 20dp with 6dp opposite-tail notch; status card cover radius matching card radius at the shared edge. Each surface commits to border OR shadow but not both — FAB keeps a layered transparent shadow (no border); cards use contrast lift against #0F1512 (no shadow, no border); the secondary status FAB uses a 1dp stroke (no shadow); the single bent rule is the 1dp intra-card settings divider. The result is visually continuous with the existing Shadowzap settings emerald, quiet enough to not fight WhatsApp's own content, clear enough that one accent carries all 'you need to act' signal, and robust on OLED dark mode because every elevation is a true contrast step on #0F1512 rather than a translucent elevation that would collapse on amoled.
